gloss: digression; side note; by the way

definitions.explanation: A remark or story that departs from the main topic. Often used as a discourse marker to introduce an aside. Composed of 余 (surplus, extra) + 談 (talk).

examples.japanese: {余談|よだん}ですが、{面白|おもしろ}い{話|はなし}があります。
examples.english: As a side note, I have an interesting story.

examples.japanese: {余談|よだん}はさておき、{本題|ほんだい}に{入|はい}りましょう。
examples.english: Setting digressions aside, let's get to the main topic.

examples.japanese: {余談|よだん}になりますが、この{建物|たてもの}には{百年|ひゃくねん}の{歴史|れきし}があるそうです。
examples.english: As an aside, I hear this building has a hundred years of history.

notes:
USAGE:
{余談|よだん} is commonly used as a discourse marker to signal that the speaker is about to say something off-topic. Common patterns include {余談|よだん}ですが (as a side note), {余談|よだん}になりますが (this is a digression, but), and {余談|よだん}はさておき (setting aside digressions).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {余談|よだん}ですが (as a side note — polite)
- {余談|よだん}はさておき (digressions aside)
- {余談|よだん}になりますが (this is off-topic, but)
- ちょっと{余談|よだん} (a brief digression)
